_about: Researched contents for sealed products that the parser gets wrong. Read by tools/ppt/sealed_contents.py. Key: TCGplayer product ID. The fields packs, mix, promos, other, and note replace the parsed fields. A field that is not here keeps its parsed value. Mix keys are set slugs, '<series> Series' for packs from an unnamed set in a named series, or 'unknown'. Every entry needs a sources list. The name field is only for the reader. An entry with an exclude field gives the reason that tools/export/catalog.py leaves the product out of the game.
